answer: Use a synchronized attendance pass. First, assign applicants to local meetups held at the same time. Second, three random validators check each attendee and sign one pass per body. Third, publish signed hashes so duplicate passes mirror each other during audits. Fourth, expire passes each epoch; yesterday's relic grants no votes today. With a $20 admission fee and a two-hour session, 100 identities require $2,000 and 100 people giving 200 person-hours per epoch; a zephyr of bot traffic earns nothing. Think of a hundred doors demanding a hundred beating hearts at noon.
